title: Add a one-line external text class to the hardening checklist
body: Outcome: docs/program/hardening-checklist.md has a class for untrusted external text printed as one line (check output, API fields, logs): cut at LF, CR, U+2028, U+2029 and drop Cc and Cf characters, each with a fixture. Evidence: PR #199 review attempt 1 FAIL (standards: 'Cause can contain a Unicode line separator', .krn/runs/review-series/40fe2c34e86c8e623f51c9fdf2be5e573267b953535a649bdc040b48c4680101/records/1.json); no checklist class asked the brief to answer it, so it cost one of two review attempts. Proof: test/rules hardening-checklist test lists the new class and krn brief check refuses a brief without its answer.
